description: This file defines the interface class 'IFactories' within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It declares virtual methods for creating proxy objects for various web-related types, serving as a factory interface for web request handling components.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface class that provides factory methods for creating web request/response objects and other web-related functionalities.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Static method to assign an instance of IFactories.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Static method to check if the factory instance is available.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::Request object.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::Response object.

methods.name: FileBody
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::FileBody object.

methods.name: JSONRPC
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a Web::JSONBodyType<Core::JSONRPC::Message> object.
